newsitem.title: GERMANY: Forwarder wins Michael Jackson distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: Forwarder wins Michael Jackson distribution deal.

text.p: German air cargo broker and forwarder Air Cargo Logistic GmbH (ACL) said it has won a 20 million mark contract to distribute Michael Jackson marketing products worldwide.
ACL managing director Thomas Rinnert said the company would be the single global logistics partner for distribution of the new Mystery brand of products.
Up to 300,000 shipments of 40 different products including soft drinks and T-shirts would be sent this year from manufacturer Mystery Drinks Deutschland GmbH starting in April, he told Reuters.
"All the products will be distributed by air. We will be able to ship 2,000 articles per day," he said.
Worldwide distribution would be timed to the concert appearances of Michael Jackson on the forthcoming Mystery tour, he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
